messages:
alex: Hey @sara — saw your escalation re: 403 + intermittent 500s on POST /v1/generate. Can you send a single failing request id and a curl we can run? Also paste auth header redacted, and whether this is hosted or dedicated.

sara: Hi Alex — thanks. This is hosted. Saw 403 on request_id=acme-req-2026-03-15-11, then later 500s with request_id=acme-req-2026-03-15-29. Here\'s minimal curl that reproduces 403 for me:
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-llama-13b\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```

alex: thanks — can you also run these quick SDK smoke checks and paste outputs? They are tiny. If failing, include request ids shown in response headers. First python:
```python
from redwood import Redwood
c = Redwood(api_key=\"REDACTED\")
print(c.generate(\"rwd-llama-13b\",\"test smoke\"))
```

ivan: small note — for JS/Golang, add explicit timeout to rule out client-side hangs.

tom: JS snippet:
```js
import {Redwood}from 'redwood'
const c = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, timeout: 5000})
await c.generate('rwd-llama-13b','smoke test').then(r=>console.log(r)).catch(e=>console.error(e))
```

deploybot: Log bundle requested: please run `curl https://internal.redwood/collect-bundle -H \"X-Req: <request_id>\"` and upload.

sara: ran python — got HTTP 403, response headers include x-rw-request-id: acme-req-2026-03-15-11, x-rw-trace: trace-9cf. Attached short log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T11:02:12Z ERROR auth: token expired for key user-acme-org
2026-03-15T11:02:13Z INFO request id=acme-req-2026-03-15-11 route=/v1/generate status=403
```

alex: that\'s helpful. Two paths: (A) Billing auth: confirm org key active & no quota block (billing portal). (B) If key looked valid, run curl with `-H \"X-Debug: true\"` to get a richer error payload and post `x-rw-request-id` header.

sara: added -H \"X-Debug: true\" — response now includes `error_code=API_KEY_EXPIRED` in body. I think token rotation happened. But the 500s still appear intermittently — here\'s a small go script that hits endpoint in loop to repro 500s:
```go
package main
import(
  \"fmt\"
  \"net/http\"
)
func main(){
  for i:=0;i<10;i++){
    resp,_:=http.Post(\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\",\"application/json\",nil)
    fmt.Println(i, resp.Status)
  }
}
```

ivan: can you capture a request id for one 500 and paste it? we\'ll trace in the runtime. Also please upload a debug bundle and the sdk logs (set RW_LOG=debug).

sara: uploaded bundle to the support ticket, request id for 500 is acme-req-2026-03-15-29. Bundle link: https://uploads.redwood/support/abc123

alex: ack — I\'ll attach to infra trace. For followups, include: exact API key prefix (first 8 chars), timestamp, and whether you saw any rate-limit headers (x-rw-rate-limit). We\'ll also confirm whether there\'s any recent billing change. I\'ll follow up with eng runtime if trace shows a kernel OOM.

tom: FYI devx: we should add a one-click \"collect smoke bundle\" in SDK that prints curl/python/js/go commands and toggles RW_LOG; small feature request.

sara: thanks team. tagging @ivan @alex — please keep me posted; customer on hold.

alex: will update in this thread once we have root cause. :thumbsup:
